I remember one time I was chatting with one of the [OPAL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_Phone_Abstraction_Library) developers at a conference once, way back in 2007. He was talking about how proud he was that they made OPAL work on so many platforms. I asked him, isn't that a super huge pain? He was like, "No, it's great. It's allowed us to identify so many bugs because the thread scheduler works a little differently on Windows, Solaris, etc." Maybe this will be an interesting opportunity to find a bug in my implementation.
